title: Oozy Velvety Moroccan Almond Chebakia
description: A traditional Moroccan dessert with a velvety texture and crunchy almond topping, featuring parsley and a lazy Sunday vibe, this jain-friendly chebakia is steamed to perfection using the mushimono method.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, almond meal, sugar, and salt.
Add the chopped parsley, almond oil, rose water, and orange blossom water to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes pliable and smooth.
Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg.
Shape each ball into a chebakia shape, with a small hole in the center.
Place the chebakia in a steamer basket lined with parchment paper.
Steam the chebakia over boiling water for 15 minutes, using the mushimono method.
Remove the chebakia from the steamer and let them cool on a wire rack.
Serve the oozy velvety Moroccan almond chebakia warm, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
